column1: # mapping_set_title: 'G7 2026 SBOM for AI Minimum Elements <-> SPDX 3.0.1'

# mapping_set_description: 'Maps the 50 minimum-element leaf concepts of SBOM for AI: Minimum Elements (G7 Cybersecurity Working Group, 2026-05-12; 7 clusters: Metadata, System Level Properties, Models, Dataset Properties, Infrastructure, Security Properties, Key Performance Indicators) to properties, classes and RelationshipType individuals of the SPDX 3.0.1 model. The 13 Metadata elements are textually identical to the CISA 2026 Minimum Elements, so their rows follow cisa2026-to-spdx30 and the SPDX implementation paper (author -> createdBy, producer -> originatedBy, dependency -> Relationship/dependsOn, hash -> Hash.hashValue + algorithm, component version -> Package.packageVersion; tool version and SBOM version have no field in 3.0.1 and are GAP rows). Rows whose comment starts with GAP identify information with no native SPDX field. The bridge_concept column cites the bridge concept from bom.ttl. The 10 composite elements dataset-description, dataset-content, dataset-provenance, dataset-sensitivity, model-description, model-prop, model-input-output-prop, model-training-prop, model-license and system-input-output-prop are broken down into 31 atomic sub-elements (notation G7AI-XX-NN.M, rule id BOM-G7AI2026-XX-NNN.M); the rows of each sub-element follow the rows of its parent element. Derived from the SPDX 3.1-dev mapping (tools/derive_spdx30.py): SPDX 3.1 is backward compatible with 3.0, so every target that exists in 3.0.1 is mapped the same way; targets added in 3.1 (Core/version, Core/intendedUse, isoAutomationLevel, byteSize, finetunedOn / pretrainedOn / validatedOn / evaluatedOn, conformsTo / Specification, SupportRelationship, ContactPointRelationship, InteractionTemplate, the Hardware profile) are replaced by the closest 3.0.1 carrier or recorded as GAP rows.'

column8: comment

CreationInfo.createdBy (1..*) -> Agent (Person or Organization) accountable for the SBOM; the generating tool belongs in createdUsing, keeping author and tool distinct. Same mapping as CISA 2026 SBOM Author.

GAP (missing field) -- ENVELOPE. No native signature property in any SPDX version; verifiedUsing + Hash proves integrity only. Wrap the serialized document in an in-toto / DSSE attestation (SPDX is a registered in-toto attestation predicate type), CMS or JWS. narrowMatch.
serializedInArtifact links the SpdxDocument to the Artifact holding its bytes; that Artifact's hash is what the external signature covers. relatedMatch.

COMPOSED. The format name (SPDX) is implied by the model instance / JSON-LD @context IRI; CreationInfo.specVersion carries the precise version. No dedicated format-name field; report the data model name, not the media type.
CreationInfo.specVersion (1..1) = exact SPDX specification version (e.g. '3.0.1'). Exact match.

Software/Sbom.sbomType (0..*; design, source, build, analyzed, deployed, runtime) states the lifecycle context and evidence used. Map 'before build' -> design/source, 'build' -> build, 'after build' -> analyzed/deployed/runtime. Not LifecycleScopedRelationship.scope (relationship-level). closeMatch (value vocabulary).
CreationInfo.created (1..1, Core/DateTime (UTC, second resolution) UTC) of the released revision; each revision is a new Sbom/SpdxDocument linked with amendedBy. Exact match.
CreationInfo.createdUsing (0..*) -> Core/Tool; Tool.name carries the tool name. Exact match.

GAP (missing field): SPDX 3.0.1 has no Tool version property (Core/version on Tool is a 3.1 addition). Tool.name conventionally carries name and version together; alternatives are an ExternalIdentifier of type packageUrl on the Tool or a Tool -> versioned Package relationship. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): SPDX 3.0.1 has no SBOM-version field (Core/version on Bom is a 3.1 addition). The amendedBy relationship gives the revision lineage; a human-readable version string can only go in Element.comment on the Sbom. broadMatch (container fallback).

Relationship amendedBy from the earlier Sbom/SpdxDocument to the revised one records the revision lineage. closeMatch. Note: the RelationshipType vocabulary says the from Element is amended by each to Element (previous -> new), while the Bom class text says the Relationship goes from the updated BOM to the original; the model contradicts itself.

An instance of Core/Relationship with relationshipType dependsOn: from = the dependent element (AI system / model), to = the dependencies (models, datasets, software, hardware). Direction matters; completeness states whether the list is complete; LifecycleScopedRelationship.scope qualifies build vs runtime. Exact match for the dependency reading.
'Includes' reading: relationshipType contains from the containing system / package to its subcomponents. closeMatch.
Generic: all typed relationships (dependsOn, contains, trainedOn, ...) are Core/Relationship elements with from, to, relationshipType. closeMatch at class level.

A Relationship with relationshipType descendantOf (from = the derived component, to = the component it was largely derived from) carries the derived-from reading of the dependency element. closeMatch.
Element.name on the AIPackage (or Package) representing the AI system. Exact match; GAP (cardinality) for alternate names (single-valued name; spdx/spdx-3-model#1432).

Relationship with relationshipType contains from the system AIPackage to each component element (models, datasets, software, hardware, services). ElementCollection.rootElement on the Sbom identifies the system as the primary element. Exact match.
Sbom.rootElement identifies the AI system element that the SBOM describes; its contains / dependsOn relationships enumerate the components. closeMatch.

Artifact.originatedBy (0..*) -> Agent: the entity that created, defined and identified the system (G7 'producer', verbatim CISA 2026 Component Producer). suppliedBy is a separate distribution role. Organization.headquartersLocation (3.1-dev) can carry the producer's country. Exact match.
Artifact.suppliedBy identifies the supplier / distributor; use only when the supplier is also the producer. closeMatch.
Software/Package.packageVersion (0..1) carries the component version string. Exact match. (SPDX 3.1 deprecates it in favour of Core/version on Package.)
Artifact.releaseTime (0..1) = release date of the system; builtTime = build date. closeMatch (G7 wording covers creation or last update).
Artifact.builtTime (0..1) for the build / assembly time. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured data-flow description. informationAboutApplication (free text) is the closest container; hasInput / hasOutput / usesTool relationships model component-level flows. broadMatch (container fallback).
AIPackage.useSensitivePersonalInformation (PresenceType) covers the sensitive-data aspect; informationAboutApplication covers the broader narrative (purpose, retention, sharing). closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured input / output schema or modality field. informationAboutApplication and typeOfModel (free text) partially cover it; AI/InteractionTemplate (3.1-dev) describes prompt-level input structure. broadMatch (container fallback). Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-SLP-08.1..3.

GAP (missing field). No structured input modality field in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. On the AIPackage representing the system, informationAboutApplication (0..1, free text) can state accepted input modalities and how they differ from the model level. broadMatch (container fallback).
AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, free text) may name a multimodal class but is not a modality list. relatedMatch.

GAP (missing field). No structured output modality field in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. On the AIPackage representing the system, informationAboutApplication (0..1, free text) can state produced output modalities. broadMatch (container fallback).
AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, free text) may name a generative class but is not a modality list. relatedMatch.

AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (0..1, free text): its definition names pre-processing applied to input data before it reaches the AI components (cleaning, normalisation, feature extraction). closeMatch (covered but unstructured).
AIPackage.domain (0..*) enumerates the intended application domains. closeMatch: AI/domain mixes technical domain and sector (spdx/spdx-3-model#659).
Element.name on the AIPackage representing the model. Exact match; GAP (cardinality) for alternate names.
Software/Package.packageUrl (0..1, PURL) is the recommended common identifier (pkg:huggingface/... for models and datasets on Hugging Face, pkg:generic/... otherwise). Exact match.
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe22 (identifier = the CPE 2.2 string). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe23. closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swid (SWID tag id). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swhid (Software Heritage persistent identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType gitoid (OmniBOR artifact or input-manifest identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
SoftwareArtifact.contentIdentifier (gitoid / swhid): intrinsic content-derived identifiers. closeMatch (subset).
The spdxId IRI of the element is globally unique and may serve as an identifier, but does not replace a common external identifier. closeMatch.
Software/Package.packageVersion (0..1) carries the component version string. Exact match. (SPDX 3.1 deprecates it in favour of Core/version on Package.)
Artifact.builtTime (0..1) = training completion time; releaseTime = publication date. closeMatch.
Artifact.releaseTime (0..1) = model release date. closeMatch.
Artifact.originatedBy (0..*) -> Agent that created / trained the model (the model developer); suppliedBy for a distributing hub or vendor. Exact match.
Artifact.suppliedBy for the distributing party; use only when it also originated the model. closeMatch.
Element.description (0..1) on the AIPackage; summary for a short form; typeOfModel for the architecture keyword. Exact match. Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-MDL-06.1..4.
AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*) records the model type / architecture (transformer, CNN, ...). closeMatch for the architecture aspect of the description.
AI/domain (0..*, free text) enumerates the application areas the model is designed for (computer vision, NLP, ...). relatedMatch (application area aspect).
Element.summary (0..1) is the short description of the AIPackage and can state its capabilities. closeMatch (free text, no structured task list).
AIPackage.limitation (0..1, free text) records known limitations and weaknesses of the model. Exact match.
Relationship descendantOf from the model AIPackage to each predecessor AIPackage it was fine-tuned or distilled from (0..* targets). Exact match for the predecessor half of lineage.

Relationship ancestorOf from the model to each known derivative model. closeMatch (derivative half of lineage; the inverse of descendantOf is normally published by the derivative model, so this direction is rarely asserted by the original producer).

SPDX 3.0.1 has no intended-use field on AIPackage (Core/intendedUse on Artifact is a 3.1 addition; Dataset/intendedUse exists for datasets only). AI/AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (0..1, free text: how the model is used, its intended application and pre-processing) is the closest carrier of the provider-declared intended use. closeMatch.
AI/AIPackage.domain (0..*, string) names the domain in which the model can be expected to operate; the sector half of an intended-use statement only. relatedMatch.
AIPackage.verifiedUsing -> Core/Hash; Hash.hashValue (1..1, lowercase hex) over the distributed weights / model artifact. Exact match.
Artifact.verifiedUsing -> Hash is the algorithm + hashValue pair that contains this element. broadMatch (container).
Hash.algorithm (1..1, HashAlgorithm vocabulary: sha256, sha512, blake3, ...). Exact match (SPDX identifiers, deterministic mapping to IANA names).
Artifact.verifiedUsing -> Hash is the algorithm + hashValue pair that contains this element. broadMatch (container).

Basket concept spread across AIPackage properties: typeOfModel, modelExplainability, autonomyType (3.1 replaces it by Core/isoAutomationLevel), safetyRiskAssessment, limitation, hyperparameter, metric, metricDecisionThreshold, energyConsumption. broadMatch. Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-MDL-09.1..4.
AIPackage.typeOfModel: architecture / model type. closeMatch (sub-aspect).
AIPackage.hyperparameter (DictionaryEntry key/value): hyper-parameters, parameter count (key 'parameters'), context length. closeMatch (sub-aspect). GAP: no dedicated parameter-count field.

AI/AIPackage.autonomyType (0..1, PresenceType yes / no / noAssertion) states whether the model can act autonomously; SPDX 3.1 replaces it by Core/isoAutomationLevel (IsoAutomationLevel scale). closeMatch for the autonomy sub-aspect.

AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, free text); its own definition cites supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement models, i.e. the learning paradigm, so the parametric or non-parametric class has no dedicated field. closeMatch (no controlled vocabulary).

GAP (missing field): no architecture property distinct from the free-text typeOfModel. AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*) can carry the architecture name (transformer, CNN, decoder-only, Llama). broadMatch: typeOfModel is a broader free text.

GAP (missing field). No parameter-count property. Record as an AIPackage.hyperparameter DictionaryEntry (0..*) with the agreed key parameters; same convention as the model-prop row. broadMatch (container fallback).
AIPackage.hyperparameter (0..*, DictionaryEntry key/value) holds the model and training hyper-parameters (layers, hidden size, learning rate, batch size). Exact match.

GAP (missing field): no structured input / output modality, size or schema field. informationAboutApplication / typeOfModel free text; AI/InteractionTemplate (3.1-dev) for prompt structure. broadMatch (container fallback). Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-MDL-10.1..4.

GAP (missing field). No structured input modality field in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (0..1, free text) is the nearest place to state accepted input modalities and size limits. broadMatch (container fallback).
AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, free text) may name a multimodal model class but is not a modality list. relatedMatch.

GAP (missing field). No structured output modality field in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (0..1, free text) is the nearest place to state produced output modalities and size limits. broadMatch (container fallback).
AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, free text) may name a generative model class but is not a modality list. relatedMatch.

GAP (missing field). No dedicated context length property. Record it as an AIPackage.hyperparameter DictionaryEntry (0..*) with the agreed key context_length and the token count as value. broadMatch (container fallback; key convention only, not standardised).

AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (0..1, free text): its definition names the pre-processing applied to input data before inference (data cleaning, normalisation, feature extraction). closeMatch (covered but unstructured). A tokenizer can additionally be a separate Package linked by dependsOn.

AIPackage.informationAboutTraining (0..1, free text) describes the training process; hyperparameter and modelDataPreprocessing add structure. closeMatch for the narrative (the cluster also spans structured training data and lifecycle relationships). Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-MDL-11.1..2.
Relationships trainedOn / testedOn (the only two types in SPDX 3.0.1; the stage goes in Relationship.comment) from the AIPackage to DatasetPackages record the training lineage. closeMatch.

AIPackage.modelDataPreprocessing (0..*): preprocessing steps applied to training data. closeMatch (sub-aspect). GAP: training compute (FLOP) and energy methodology have no field; energyConsumption carries energy quantities.

AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, free text): its definition covers supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning models. closeMatch (no controlled value list; self-supervised and semi-supervised are not named).
AIPackage.informationAboutTraining (0..1, free text) describes training algorithms and techniques, including the learning paradigm. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field). No structured post-training field. AIPackage.informationAboutTraining (0..1, free text) can describe fine-tuning stages, instruction tuning, RLHF, DPO / PPO / GRPO and continual learning. broadMatch (container fallback).

Relationship trainedOn from the AIPackage to the fine-tuning DatasetPackage, with the fine-tuning stage stated in Relationship.comment (SPDX 3.0.1 has no finetunedOn; 3.1 adds it), identifies the data of a fine-tuning stage; descendantOf links the base model. relatedMatch: records the data, not the technique.

Relationship hasDeclaredLicense from the AIPackage to an AnyLicenseInfo (LicenseExpression, ListedLicense, CustomLicense for RAIL-style or proprietary model licences; NoAssertionLicense when unknown). Exact match; model text: hasDeclaredLicense = license info the Artifact was discovered to contain, hasConcludedLicense = license the data creator concludes governs it -- either may carry the governing-license statement. Atomic sub-element: G7AI-MDL-12.1.
SimpleLicensing/LicenseExpression.licenseExpression carries the SPDX licence expression string. closeMatch (value field).

GAP (missing field). No openness class (open weight, open architecture, open data, open training) in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. Openness can only be inferred from the hasDeclaredLicense relationships of the separate weights, code and DatasetPackage elements. relatedMatch.
Element.externalRef (0..*) -> ExternalRef {externalRefType: documentation (model card, paper), altWebPage, vcs, altDownloadLocation, metrics, other; locator}. Exact match.
A bundled model card or paper is a File / Package linked by relationshipType hasDocumentation. closeMatch.
Element.name on the DatasetPackage. Exact match.

Element.description on the DatasetPackage; Core/intendedUse states the dataset's intended use. closeMatch (composite; sub-elements carry role / availability / confidentiality). Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-DP-02.1..3.

Dataset/DatasetPackage.intendedUse (0..1, free text; SPDX 3.1 replaces it by Core/intendedUse on Artifact) describes the scope and boundaries of appropriate applications of the dataset, i.e. the application-facing intended use that a consumer sees; the lifecycle role (pre-training, fine-tuning, evaluation, benchmark) is an internal development-process fact and is only incidentally stated there. Dataset/intendedUse is deprecated in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. relatedMatch.

The lifecycle role is asserted structurally by the Relationship from the AIPackage to the DatasetPackage: trainedOn or testedOn (0..* per model; SPDX 3.0.1 has only these two, the finer stage goes in Relationship.comment; 3.1 adds pretrainedOn, finetunedOn, validatedOn, evaluatedOn). narrowMatch because trainedOn is one of the role types (trainedOn and testedOn in 3.0.1; 3.1 adds pretrainedOn, finetunedOn, validatedOn, evaluatedOn) and the role is a property of each use by a model, not of the dataset on its own. No RelationshipType exists for benchmark, context extension or retrieval roles (GAP (vocabulary)).

DatasetPackage.datasetAvailability (0..1, DatasetAvailabilityType: directDownload, query, registration, clickthrough, scrapingScript). Exact match for the access aspect; a private dataset is expressed by omitting the property and recording the sharing restriction in confidentialityLevel.

DatasetPackage.confidentialityLevel (0..1, ConfidentialityLevelType, Traffic Light Protocol based: clear, green, amber, amberStrict, red). Exact match for the confidentiality reading of public or private.

DatasetPackage.datasetType (1..*, DatasetType: text, image, audio, video, structured, timeseries, sensor, categorical, numeric, graph, timestamp, syntactic, other, noAssertion) gives the content modality; Core/inLanguage lists languages. narrowMatch: datasetType is one aspect (the modality) of the composite dataset content. Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-DP-03.1..3.

GAP (missing field). No dataset domain property in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. Element.description (0..1) on the DatasetPackage is the fallback: state the subject domain (financial data, medical records, legal text, ...) in the description text. broadMatch because Element.description is a broader free-text container; the domain is stated inside it without structure or controlled values.

AI/domain (0..*, free text) is defined on AIPackage only, so it cannot be set on a DatasetPackage; it records the domain in which a model can operate, not the domain of data content. relatedMatch (same notion, wrong class).

GAP (missing field) on DatasetPackage: no dataset format property. Core/contentType (0..1, MediaType such as text/csv or application/json) exists on Software/File only, so the serialisation format is representable per distribution file, with the File linked from the DatasetPackage by contains / hasDistributionArtifact. closeMatch (per-file media type approximates the dataset format; encoding or schema detail is not covered).

DatasetPackage.datasetType (1..*, DatasetType vocabulary: audio, categorical, graph, image, numeric, sensor, structured, syntactic, text, timeseries, timestamp, video, other, noAssertion). Exact match; modalities without a vocabulary value (e.g. 3D) use other. Multimodal datasets repeat the property.
Software/Package.packageUrl (0..1, PURL) is the recommended common identifier (pkg:huggingface/... for models and datasets on Hugging Face, pkg:generic/... otherwise). Exact match.
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe22 (identifier = the CPE 2.2 string). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe23. closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swid (SWID tag id). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swhid (Software Heritage persistent identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType gitoid (OmniBOR artifact or input-manifest identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
SoftwareArtifact.contentIdentifier (gitoid / swhid): intrinsic content-derived identifiers. closeMatch (subset).
The spdxId IRI of the element is globally unique and may serve as an identifier, but does not replace a common external identifier. closeMatch.

DatasetPackage.verifiedUsing -> Core/Hash {algorithm, hashValue} over the dataset archive (or per-File hashes for multi-file datasets). closeMatch at property level; the Hash fields are mapped separately.
Hash.hashValue (1..1, hexadecimal string) is the digest. narrowMatch (one aspect of the algorithm + digest pair).
Hash.algorithm (1..1, HashAlgorithm vocabulary). narrowMatch (one aspect of the algorithm + digest pair).

DatasetPackage.dataCollectionProcess (0..1): how and from where the data was gathered. narrowMatch: the collection narrative is one aspect of the composite provenance; originatedBy / suppliedBy give the source organisation, datasetAvailability the access mode, datasetUpdateMechanism the update cadence. Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-DP-06.1..4.
DatasetPackage.dataPreprocessing (0..*): preprocessing / curation steps. narrowMatch (one aspect of the composite provenance) (sub-aspect).
Artifact.originatedBy on the DatasetPackage names the source organisation / curator. narrowMatch (the who-aspect, bom:dataset-source, of the composite provenance).

Artifact.originatedBy (0..*) -> Agent (Person or Organization) names the creator of the dataset. closeMatch: covers the creator aspect only; other contributing sources and organisations are separate DatasetPackage elements.

Upstream datasets from which this dataset is derived or assembled are separate DatasetPackage elements linked by descendantOf (from = this dataset, to = each source dataset). relatedMatch (derivation sources; non-dataset sources such as web crawls need free text in dataCollectionProcess).
DatasetPackage.dataCollectionProcess (0..1, free text) describes how the data was gathered (crawling, sensors, surveys, licensed purchase). Exact match.
DatasetPackage.dataPreprocessing (0..*, free text) records pre-processing, curation, cleaning and labelling steps applied to the data. Exact match on the dataset side.

AIPackage.modelDataPreprocessing (0..*, free text) records the same kind of steps from the model side (what was applied to the data before training). closeMatch (different owner class; use when the dataset element is not published).

GAP (missing field). No synthetic-data flag or generator field in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. Describe the generation method, model or simulator in dataCollectionProcess (0..1, free text). broadMatch because dataCollectionProcess is a broader free-text container that also carries other collection information.

The generating model or tool can be linked as a separate AIPackage (or Tool) element with relationshipType generates (from = generator, to = DatasetPackage). relatedMatch: records the generator but not the method parameters.

Dataset/DatasetPackage.datasetSize (0..1, nonNegativeInteger, bytes; SPDX 3.1 replaces it by Software/byteSize) is the only numeric size field; number of data points and their unit have no field (GAP). datasetNoise and knownBias cover quality and bias. closeMatch at cluster level.
DatasetPackage.knownBias (0..*) and datasetNoise (0..1) cover bias and noise characteristics. closeMatch (sub-aspect).

DatasetPackage.hasSensitivePersonalInformation (PresenceType) + confidentialityLevel (clear, green, amber, amberStrict, red) + anonymizationMethodUsed form the sensitivity cluster. narrowMatch: the personal-data flag is one aspect of the composite sensitivity cluster. Atomic sub-elements: G7AI-DP-08.1..3.
DatasetPackage.confidentialityLevel (ConfidentialityLevelType). narrowMatch (one aspect of the composite sensitivity) (sub-aspect).

DatasetPackage.hasSensitivePersonalInformation (0..1, PresenceType: yes, no, noAssertion). closeMatch for the presence statement: SPDX words it as sensitive personal information, so a dataset with only non-sensitive personal data is a judgement call for the creator.

DatasetPackage.anonymizationMethodUsed (0..*, free text) covers the anonymisation or pseudonymisation applied. closeMatch (sub-aspect of the G7 sub-element). On the model side use AIPackage.useSensitivePersonalInformation.

GAP (missing field). SPDX has no property for the copyright status of content contained in a dataset. Software/copyrightText (0..1) is the copyright notice of the artifact itself, not of its contents. relatedMatch.
hasDeclaredLicense describes the licence of the dataset as an artifact (see dataset-license), not the rights or opt-out status of third-party content inside it. relatedMatch.

GAP (missing field). No property for categories of sensitive or regulated data (financial, medical, biometric, national security). confidentialityLevel (0..1, TLP based) states only the sharing restriction that follows from sensitivity. relatedMatch: confidentialityLevel covers the restriction aspect only; the categories themselves need free text in Element.description.
trainedOn (from = model, to = dataset) is the model-side edge; the G7 element describes the software used on the dataset and dataset-to-dataset derivation. relatedMatch.

A LifecycleScopedRelationship with relationshipType dependsOn (scope build or other) from the DatasetPackage to the software packages used to create, modify and maintain it; usesTool is the alternative for tooling. closeMatch.

A Relationship with relationshipType descendantOf (from = the derived dataset, to = the dataset it was largely derived from) carries the derived-from reading of the G7 element. closeMatch (the G7 element bundles tooling and derivation readings).
Relationship hasDeclaredLicense from the DatasetPackage to an AnyLicenseInfo (CC licences are ListedLicenses; terms of use as CustomLicense). Exact match.
SimpleLicensing/LicenseExpression.licenseExpression for the licence expression string. closeMatch (value field).

Software/Package elements (name, version, packageUrl) for frameworks, runtimes, container images and OS layers. closeMatch: Package is the class of every software package; the dependsOn relationship identifies the infrastructure items.
LifecycleScopedRelationship with relationshipType dependsOn and scope runtime / build links the system / model to its infrastructure software. closeMatch.

GAP (missing profile): SPDX 3.0.1 has no Hardware profile and no runsOn relationship (both are 3.1 additions). Accelerators and hosts can only be described as free text (Element.comment, AIPackage.informationAboutTraining for training hardware) or modelled as generic Package elements linked by dependsOn. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no security-controls field. ExternalRef (securityPolicy, securityThreatModel, securityAdversaryModel, securityPenTestReport, secureSoftwareAttestation, other) links the relevant documents. broadMatch (container fallback).

AI/AIPackage.standardCompliance (0..*, string) lists the standards the AI package complies with. exactMatch. (SPDX 3.1 deprecates it in favour of a conformsTo Relationship to a Specification / Regulation element.)

Artifact.standardName (0..*, string) names a standard applicable to the artifact; the model states it does not imply compliance (in 3.0.1 AIPackage.standardCompliance states that; 3.1 adds conformsTo Relationships). relatedMatch.
ExternalRef with externalRefType securityPolicy links the vulnerability-disclosure policy or security.txt (locator = URL). closeMatch.

Security profile: Security/Vulnerability elements (ExternalIdentifier cve) + VexAffected / VexFixed / VexNotAffected / VexUnderInvestigation relationships + CVSS / EPSS / SSVC / ExploitCatalog assessments. Exact match.
VEX status per vulnerability and component. closeMatch (status aspect).
ExternalRef with externalRefType securityAdvisory links an external advisory or vulnerability database entry. closeMatch.
ExternalRef with externalRefType vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment links an external VEX or exploitability statement. closeMatch.

AIPackage.metric (DictionaryEntry) and metricDecisionThreshold carry model-level security / robustness metrics; vulnerability scores (CVSS, EPSS, SSVC) live in Security profile assessment relationships. closeMatch.
AIPackage.metric (DictionaryEntry) and metricDecisionThreshold carry accuracy, F1, latency, throughput, bias and similar KPIs; energyConsumption carries energy KPIs (kWh / MJ). closeMatch.
AIPackage.energyConsumption -> EnergyConsumption {training / finetuning / inferenceEnergyConsumption -> energyQuantity, energyUnit}. relatedMatch (energy KPI sub-aspect).
